# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `trivago` MCP server pointing at `https://mcp.trivago.com/mcp`.
- No sign-in, API key, or client ID: the server is public and its tools are read-only.
- Listed for Cursor and Grok Bot.
- Logo: trivago's official symbol, from `imgcy.trivago.com`.
